name: NOBEL_READINESS_AND_NOMINATION_STRATEGY
principle: Do not market IMA or Ori as Nobel nominees unless a valid nomination is actually made by an eligible nominator and the relevant institution confirms it only when disclosure is permitted.

scope.economic_sciences: Separate prize administered with the Nobel prizes; not one of Alfred Nobel's original five categories.
not_nobel_categories: other fields without a Nobel category

strategy.primary_goal: Create independently verifiable, world-level contributions whose significance could plausibly meet Nobel-level standards.
strategy.secondary_goal: Build nomination-ready and award-ready evidence across Nobel and major international prizes while creating the underlying real-world achievements first.

peace.evidence: measurable conflict prevention, peacebuilding, human agency, cross-border impact

literature.ima_fit: Ori and published literary work only
literature.evidence: outstanding literary body of work with independent critical recognition

medicine.evidence: major validated life-science/medical discovery of paradigm-level importance

economic_sciences.evidence: major validated contribution to economic sciences

execution.research: Continuously map IMA work to Nobel criteria and identify missing scientific, literary and peace-impact evidence.
execution.evidence: Maintain reproducible papers, datasets, deployments, independent evaluations, citations, real-world outcomes and provenance.
execution.independence: Seek independent experts, institutions and replication; never manufacture endorsements.
execution.nomination: Identify only legitimate eligible nominators for each category and prepare nomination-ready evidence; no self-nomination.
execution.timeline: Reassess annually before nomination deadlines; do not claim nomination unless actually submitted by an eligible nominator.

hard_rules: No fabricated Nobel affiliation, nomination, endorsement or finalist status.
No payment or quid-pro-quo for a nomination.
Do not misrepresent an AI system as a human laureate candidate.
A Nobel-level aspiration is not evidence of Nobel-level achievement.
next_actions: Maintain the canonical Nobel and global-awards evidence matrix.
Create measurable peace, human-agency, accessibility and education impact evidence.
Publish high-quality technical/research outputs with reproducibility and independent review.
Build and maintain Ori's literary bibliography and independent critical recognition.
Track major international awards beyond Nobel and re-check official rules before each cycle.
Prepare award packets while stopping at mandatory human, legal, nomination and identity boundaries.
Never infer nomination, finalist status or award from submission or outreach.
